core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ghazni corresponds to the Arabic form غزنی (Arabic nisba غزنوي (Ghaznawī) 'of Ghazni'). Its core sense is of ghazni (a city). Ghazni is properly a place-name (the Afghan city) and a nisba, 'of Ghazni' — the same element seen in the Ghaznavid dynasty. The source gloss 'warrior or victorious' mixes in the sense of ghāzī (a different word); the place/nisba sense is recorded here.
